text: A user can register with either an email or a mobile number, plus a password.
acceptance_criteria: reject registration when no password is provided (400)
reject registration when neither email nor mobile is provided (400)
accept registration with email + password and return a user_id
never store the raw password (store only a hash)

text: After five consecutive failed login attempts, the account is locked.
acceptance_criteria: lock the account on the 5th consecutive failed login
a locked account returns 403 on subsequent login attempts
a successful login resets the consecutive-failure count to zero

text: A password reset link is single-use and time-limited.
acceptance_criteria: reject an unknown/invalid reset token (400)
reject a reset token that has already been used (400)
reject an expired reset token (400)
accept a valid, unused, unexpired reset token

text: The restaurant listing shows only open restaurants and supports sorting by rating and by delivery time.
acceptance_criteria: exclude restaurants whose status is not 'open'
sort_by=rating returns the highest average_rating first
sort_by=delivery_time returns the lowest estimated_delivery_time first

text: A menu item exposes its availability, and an unknown item id returns not-found.
acceptance_criteria: return 404 for an unknown menu item id
return the item with its availability flag for a known id

text: The cart rejects unavailable items and does not allow combining items from more than one restaurant.
acceptance_criteria: reject adding an item whose available flag is false (400)
reject adding an item from a different restaurant than the cart's current restaurant (400)

text: Checkout is blocked only when the subtotal is BELOW the restaurant's minimum order value; a subtotal exactly equal to the minimum is allowed.
acceptance_criteria: reject checkout when subtotal is strictly less than the minimum (400)
allow checkout when subtotal equals the minimum order value
allow checkout when subtotal is greater than the minimum

text: Payments support card and cash-on-delivery; raw card data is never persisted.
acceptance_criteria: reject cash-on-delivery when the restaurant does not permit it (400)
for card payments store only a tokenized reference, never the raw card number
report that raw card data was not persisted

text: Delivery assignment picks the closest available agent, breaking ties by lowest current load.
acceptance_criteria: choose the agent with the smallest distance_km
when distances tie, choose the agent with the lowest current_load

text: Order status may only advance one step along Accepted -> Preparing -> Ready -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered.
acceptance_criteria: allow a transition to the immediate next status
reject a transition that skips a status
reject a transition involving an unknown status

text: A delivered order accepts exactly one review with a rating between 1 and 5 inclusive.
acceptance_criteria: reject a rating below 1 or above 5 (400)
reject a second review for the same order (400)
accept a valid first review with a rating from 1 to 5

text: Frontend user journey: signing up lands the user on the restaurants page (primary E2E flow).
acceptance_criteria: submitting the signup form (email + password) calls the register API
on success the app navigates to /restaurants
the /restaurants page renders a welcome heading with id 'welcome-msg' containing 'Welcome'

text: Frontend: the signup page shows an error and stays on the page when registration fails.
acceptance_criteria: on API failure an error message (.field-error) is shown to the user
the app does not navigate away when signup fails

text: Frontend: the restaurants page fetches and lists the available restaurants.
acceptance_criteria: on mount it calls the list-restaurants API
each restaurant renders as a link to /restaurants/:id showing name, cuisine and rating
on API error it renders an empty list without crashing

text: Frontend: the checkout page confirms an order and navigates to the confirmation page.
acceptance_criteria: clicking Confirm Order calls checkout then confirm-order APIs
on success the app navigates to /order-confirmation
on failure an error message (.field-error) is shown
